agents_hint: Agent Definitions. Changes apply to the next message without a restart.
agent_offline: This Agent is offline; the conversation is read-only.
compacted_divider: Earlier messages were summarized for the Agent
delete_confirm: Delete this conversation? This cannot be undone.
providers_hint: Providers and Models from the Catalog. Changes apply to the next message without a restart.
provider_key_unreadable: The stored API key cannot be decrypted (ORQESTRA_ENCRYPTION_KEY changed?). Enter it again.
provider_not_in_catalog: This Provider is no longer in the Catalog; its Models are unavailable.
delete_provider_confirm: Delete this Provider with its API key and enabled Models?
no_models_member: No Model is configured yet. Please contact an Admin.
no_models_admin: No Model is configured yet. Add a Provider in the Console.
model_unavailable: Warning: Model {model} is not available; this Agent no longer offers it.
agent_no_models: Warning: no Model is available, so this Agent is offline.
agent_description_hint: When this Agent should be used; also shown to Agents choosing a Subagent template.
agent_thinking_allowed_hint: None selected: every level the Model supports.
agent_memory_hint: Remembers each user across conversations: reads and writes their memories.
agent_pickable_hint: Off: only used as a Subagent template; existing conversations continue.
delete_agent_confirm: Delete this Agent? Its conversations become read-only.
tool_unavailable: Warning: Tool {tool} has no usable Search Provider, so Agents run without it.
mcp_server_unavailable: Warning: MCP Server {server} is disabled or not configured, so Agents run without it.
agent_skills_hint: Disabled Skills are unavailable, and every Skill is while no Sandbox Provider is configured; they stay in the definition.
skill_unavailable: Warning: Skill {skill} is disabled or no Sandbox Provider is configured, so Agents run without it.
skill_not_usable: /skill:{name} is not a Skill this Agent can use now: it may be disabled, deleted or not allowed for this Agent.
search_providers_hint: External services that serve the Search and Scrape Tools.
delete_search_provider_confirm: Delete this Search Provider with its API key? Tools it serves become unavailable.
memory_undo_changed: This memory has changed since, so this cannot be undone.
memory_undo_full: Memories are at their limit, so this one cannot be restored.
file_not_found: This file is no longer in the Sandbox.
file_sandbox_gone: The Sandbox that held this file was deleted, and the file with it.
file_unavailable: The Sandbox cannot be reached right now. Try again later.
incognito_hint: Memory stays off and this conversation is never recalled. This can't be changed later.
mcp_servers_hint: External services that serve Tools to Agents over the Model Context Protocol (Streamable HTTP).
mcp_headers_hint: Leave a value blank to keep the stored one; this only works while the header name stays the same.
mcp_server_id_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes; cannot be changed later.
mcp_header_unreadable: A stored header value cannot be decrypted (ORQESTRA_ENCRYPTION_KEY changed?), so this MCP Server is unavailable. Enter it again.
delete_mcp_server_confirm: Delete this MCP Server with its headers?
mcp_test_ok: Saved and connected. This MCP Server offers these Tools:
mcp_test_no_tools: Saved and connected, but this MCP Server offers no Tools.
mcp_test_auth: Saved, but authentication failed; check the headers: {detail}
mcp_test_unreachable: Saved, but the MCP Server cannot be reached; check the URL: {detail}
mcp_test_timeout: Saved, but the MCP Server did not answer in time.
mcp_test_failed: Saved, but the connection test failed: {detail}
mcp_header_invalid: "{header}" is not a valid header name.
skills_hint: Know-how in the Agent Skills format: a folder with a SKILL.md and any scripts, references and assets. Upload it as a zip or write it here; every upload or edit makes a new version.
no_skills: Upload a zip with a SKILL.md at its root or in its only top-level folder, or create a new one.
delete_skill_confirm: Delete this Skill with all its versions? It is removed from every Agent Definition.
skill_exists_confirm: A Skill named {name} already exists. Upload this as its new version?
skill_rollback_confirm: Make v{number} the current version? Agents use it from their next Run.
skill_zip_invalid: This is not a zip file Orqestra can read (only stored and deflated entries, no zip64).
skill_md_missing: No SKILL.md found: put exactly one at the root of the zip or in its only top-level folder.
skill_frontmatter_invalid: The frontmatter of SKILL.md is not valid YAML.
skill_name_invalid: SKILL.md needs a name: lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, at most 64 characters.
skill_name_mismatch: The name {name} in SKILL.md must match its folder {folder}.
skill_description_invalid: SKILL.md needs a description of 1 to 1024 characters.
skill_too_large: The Skill is larger than 10 MB unzipped.
skill_too_many_files: The Skill has more than 200 files.
skill_symlink: {path} is a symbolic link, which Skills cannot contain.
skill_md_nested: {path} is a second SKILL.md: a Skill has exactly one, at its root.
skill_file_binary: {path} is a binary file: it can only be kept or deleted here.
skill_exists: A Skill with this name already exists.
new_skill_hint: Starts the Skill with a SKILL.md holding its name and description; then edit its files to write the instructions.
skill_binary_file: Binary file of {size} bytes: it can only be deleted here. To replace it, upload the Skill again.
save_id_invalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter or digit.
save_not_found: It no longer exists; reload the page.
save_not_in_catalog: This is not in the Catalog.
save_default_required: Make another Agent the default instead.
save_default_not_pickable: The default Agent must be pickable by Users.
save_default_model_not_allowed: "{model}" is not one of the allowed Models.
save_thinking_default_not_allowed: "{level}" is not one of the allowed thinking levels.
sandbox_provider_hint: The orrery instance that serves Sandboxes, where Agents read their Skills and run their scripts. Without one, every Skill is unavailable.
delete_sandbox_provider_confirm: Delete the Sandbox Provider with its API Token? Every Skill becomes unavailable.
sandbox_snapshot_hint: A Snapshot name or SnapshotVersion id; leave blank for orrery's default Platform Snapshot.
sandbox_token_unreadable: The stored API Token cannot be decrypted (ORQESTRA_ENCRYPTION_KEY changed?), so every Skill is unavailable. Enter it again.
sandbox_test_auth: Saved, but orrery refused the API Token: {detail}
sandbox_test_unreachable: Saved, but orrery cannot be reached; check the address: {detail}
sandbox_test_timeout: Saved, but orrery did not answer in time.
sandbox_test_failed: Saved, but the connection test failed: {detail}
no_providers: Add a Provider with its API key, then enable its Models.
no_mcp_servers: Add an MCP Server so its Tools can be given to Agents.
no_search_providers: Add a Search Provider to serve the Search and Scrape Tools.
memory_page_hint: What agents remember about you across conversations. Only you can see and change it.
memory_off_notice: Memory is off: your memories are kept, but no agent reads or writes them until you turn it back on.
memory_delete_all_confirm: Delete all your memories? This cannot be undone.
no_memories: Agents with memory write down what you tell them to remember here.
limits_hint: Caps on Scheduled Tasks, Timers, Unattended Runs and Subagents. Changes apply from the next Run.
limits_saved: Saved. The next Run uses them.
